summary_en: The study tests defactinib and avutometinib, with or without encorafenib, in people with cutaneous melanoma that has spread to the brain. Defactinib and avutometinib are taken by mouth in 28-day cycles, with 3 weeks of dosing followed by 1 week of rest; avutometinib is 3.2 mg twice a week and defactinib is 200 mg twice a day, while encorafenib is taken by mouth daily in a dose-finding part of the study. The study measures preliminary response rate and safety and tolerability, and it is a Phase 1b/2 trial.
summary_es: El estudio evalúa defactinib y avutometinib, con o sin encorafenib, en personas con melanoma cutáneo que se ha extendido al cerebro. Defactinib y avutometinib se toman por vía oral en ciclos de 28 días, con 3 semanas de tratamiento seguidas de 1 semana de descanso; avutometinib es de 3.2 mg dos veces por semana y defactinib es de 200 mg dos veces al día, mientras que encorafenib se toma por vía oral todos los días en una parte del estudio para definir la dosis. El estudio mide la tasa de respuesta preliminar y la seguridad y tolerabilidad, y es un ensayo de Fase 1b/2.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with melanoma that has spread to the brain.
At least one brain metastasis that has not been treated, sized 0.5 cm to 4 cm on MRI.
Tumor with a known RAS, BRAF, or NF1 mutation, or triple wild-type status.
Received at least one prior line of immunotherapy.
ECOG performance status 0 or 1, or Karnofsky score 70 or higher.
not_for: Symptomatic brain metastasis with neurologic symptoms of grade 2 or higher.
History of interstitial lung disease or certain other lung conditions.
Uncontrolled or severe heart disease, or blood pressure above 160/100 despite treatment.
